turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Hi Marcus! How is your Wednesday going over in Portland?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hey! It's going pretty well, thanks. Had a solid start today. I made myself a yogurt parfait for breakfast, which was really good and kept me full for a while.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Yum, that sounds like a great breakfast to kick off the day. Did you have a busy morning at the high school?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yeah, we had chemistry labs all morning, so I was on my feet quite a bit. But I still managed to squeeze in a workout after classes ended—I went and did some gym weights today.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Nice job finding the energy for gym weights after teaching all day! Do you have any plans to unwind tonight, or maybe spend some time on your woodworking?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: No woodworking tonight. I actually just finished up a project recently, so my workshop is quiet today.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: It's always nice to have a finished project under your belt. Is Grace planning to help you brainstorm your next piece?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Haha, she usually just lets me do my thing, though she does have final approval on where my projects go in the house. Tonight we're both pretty tired, so we're just going to relax and watch a nature documentary.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: A nature documentary sounds like the perfect way to spend a Wednesday evening. Do you two have a specific one lined up?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: We're going to start one about deep-sea creatures. It's always fascinating to see what's down there.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Deep-sea stuff is always so mesmerizing. I hope you and Grace enjoy it! Is there anything else you need help organizing for tomorrow?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: No, I think I'm all set for tonight. Just looking forward to relaxing. Talk to you tomorrow!
